test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, RUBBER is coded as 101 and JELLY is coded as 76. How will LABEL be coded in the same language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The letters are __**replaced by the place value of the reverse letter and then numbers are added together**__, then __**the value obtained is added by 5**__, and we obtain the code

In the word, **RUBBER** is coded as **101**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edcb937bcbfd4b12f699bcf8d25bff3e713f01628097d2f28c95e8bd8294f0cb.png] 

In the same way, the word **JELLY** is coded as **76**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47895c9183fde6a0cd000563f28142cae9c4be542c765accac5e74201f0464ac.png] 

Similarly, the word **LABEL** is coded as,

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42befb20ba8f75684fef51757199bade617d142627c7e35440ebb6c0d609a1d4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **'108'.**
